title: Polka Portals shield, 2048 px PNG
usage: High-resolution raster for print proofs and video.
rules: Clear space: half the shield width on every side.
Minimum size: 48 px tall for the full shield; below that use polka-shield-small.svg (32 px) or the favicon.
Three inks only (ink #151519, paper #F6F5F2, crimson #A0112B). Never recolour, outline, add effects, rotate or stretch.
One shield per surface. The hooded Phantom is the character, not the logo; never combine them into one mark.
license: Project-original artwork for Polka Portals. Owner-controlled; all rights reserved by the project owner. Wordmark letterforms are outlined from Space Grotesk (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
